---
name: "Review a pull request"
description: "Review a pull request in Bug triage fix verify."
agent: "code-reviewer"
---

Review the current pull request independently of its author.

Check correctness against the acceptance criteria, test coverage, security, error handling,
and adherence to the standards in .github/instructions/. Give specific, actionable feedback.
End with STATUS: APPROVED or STATUS: CHANGES REQUIRED.
